description: Declare a Vercel project's deployment stream as an external Dagster asset. Pair with vercel_deployment_sensor.

project_id.description: Vercel project ID (prj_...). Preferred — stable across renames.
project_id.label: Project ID

project_name.description: Vercel project slug (URL name). Set this OR project_id.
project_name.label: Project Name

team_id.description: Vercel team ID (team_...). For team-scoped projects.
team_id.label: Team ID

vercel_dashboard_url.description: Full Vercel dashboard URL for the project (surfaces as a clickable link).
vercel_dashboard_url.label: Vercel Dashboard URL

production_url.description: Canonical production URL (e.g. https://my-site.com). Surfaces as a clickable link.
production_url.label: Production URL
